aweme_info.desc: what’s crazy is i weigh the exact same in both clips 😃😃  the first video i was already into my fitness journey & had made a lot of progress but i just cut down weight. i was in no way “fat” but was clearly still very unhappy with my body. this is what i call “skinny fat”. i only focused on counting calories, doing cardio, & barely lifted bc i was afraid of getting bulky ☺️❤️ yet i had literally no shape and losing more weight without building anything was actually making me look WORSE 🤣!! lol hopefully this can motivate someone to not be afraid of weights and start freakinggg lifting.  alsooo this is ur friendly reminder why soley getting smaller n smaller should not be the goal. focus on building muscle & losing body FAT!!!! not just weight gang. ok bye i love u full outfit after @DFYNE - dc ‘gaymer’ ❤️‍🔥 #fyp #fatloss #lifting #bodytransformation #gymgirl

I'm 51, and here's what I wish I'd understood sooner…
You don’t have to have it all figured out to enjoy your life.
You don't have to wait until you lose weight, reach your goals, have more money, or get everything in life figured out to be happy.
Stop putting your happiness on hold.
Take care of yourself. Chase your dreams. Wear the bikini. Book the trip. Laugh more. Live more.
Life is happening NOW. Don't wait for the perfect moment to enjoy it. ❤️
What's one thing you've been putting off? Maybe it's time to stop waiting. 🐝

ฉันอายุ 51 แล้ว และนี่คือสิ่งที่อยากให้ตัวเองเข้าใจตั้งนานแล้ว…

เพราะชีวิตกำลังเกิดขึ้นอยู่ตอนนี้ อย่ารอให้ทุกอย่างสมบูรณ์แบบก่อน แล้วค่อยเริ่มมีความสุข ❤️
